name: Awesome MCP Servers
headline: awesome mcp servers for task automation
short_description: Automate server management tasks with a collection of MCP servers. Ideal for operations teams to streamline server operations, reduce manual workload, and improve efficiency. Connects to existing server infrastructure and workflows.
author: punkpeye

sections.overview:
awesome-mcp-servers is a comprehensive directory of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers maintained as an open-source collection. The project aggregates MCP server implementations that allow AI agents and coding assistants to extend their capabilities by connecting to external systems, APIs, and tools. With over 87,000 stars on GitHub and active community contributions, it serves as a central resource for developers seeking to discover and integrate available MCP servers. The directory is regularly updated with new server implementations and supports multiple languages, making it accessible to a global developer audience. Teams building with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agents can reference this curated list to identify compatible servers for their integration needs.
Integrate multiple AI models into a single application using MCP servers for streamlined functionality.
Automate database interactions and file management tasks through secure MCP connections.
Set up a local development environment that communicates with various APIs for testing and deployment.
Utilize MCP servers to create a unified interface for accessing diverse AI services and tools.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers`
sections.usage:
```
Set up an automated backup schedule for our [SERVER_TYPE] servers using the MCP server automation tool. Configure backups to run [FREQUENCY] at [TIME]. Ensure backups are stored in [STORAGE_LOCATION] and notify [TEAM_EMAIL] upon completion. Include error handling for failed backups.
```
Copy

```
The automated backup schedule for your Linux servers has been successfully configured. Backups will run daily at 2:00 AM and will be stored in the AWS S3 bucket 'company-backups'. The Operations team at ops@example.com will receive a notification upon completion. Error handling has been set up to retry failed backups twice before alerting the team. The backup process includes a pre-backup check to ensure sufficient disk space and a post-backup verification to confirm data integrity.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
